citations.assessment: The guarantor is Moshe bar Atzrei in the checked Bavli. His son Huna is a scholar and the proposed claim is against his father.
Discovery of the priesthood rules out remarriage and introduces the proverb.
The other tractate explicitly has the same guarantor, his son, and the proposal.
The second passage also notes Huna’s priesthood and Abaye’s poverty proverb.
